title: List apps that open automatically at login on macOS
summary: Shows the names of the apps and items that start automatically when you log in to your Mac. The command only reads this list and changes nothing.

aliases.text: apps that start at login mac
what opens when my mac starts
task manager startup tab on mac
which programs launch at login on macos
какие программы запускаются при входе на mac

steps.explain: Ask System Events, the macOS service that manages the user session, for the names of all login items. This only reads the list. If macOS asks whether Terminal may control System Events, allow it; this is the automation permission and it is needed only once.
steps.cmd: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get the name of every login item'
steps.expect: A comma-separated list of app names, for example: Dropbox, Spotify, Rectangle. An empty result means no login items are set.

steps.explain: To see the same list with the on/off switches and to change it, open System Settings in the graphical interface. Login items are shown there, not in Terminal.
steps.gui: Apple menu > System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions. The list shows the apps that open when you log in.
